text:
alex-k: Quick post-engagement triage for the ACME engagement (whitebox). Report landed at 09:02, dropping notes so we can coordinate remediations + retest.

maria-s: Can someone confirm where the evidence bundle is and what artifacts are inside?

penbot: Report uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/pen-tests/acme/3141592653/report.pdf; metadata: report_id=ACME-2026-3141592653, assessor=NightfallSec, summary=3 high, 12 med, 21 low.

cheng-l: I pulled the bundle -> PoC scripts, curl logs, and sanitized DB snapshots. I placed them at /evidence/acme/3141592653/ and created a presigned link in the ticket.

samir: From a quick read: two authz issues (token replay and excessive kube-deploy role), one KMS misuse pattern in staging, and several telemetry blindspots. I'll do a first-pass categorization.

alex-k: Good. Maria, can you own the RBAC fixes? We need least-privilege patches and a short-lived token policy. Also need owners to validate and collect audit log proofs.

maria-s: I'll open RBAC tickets. Plan: kube role restriction PR + CI token policy PR. Will assign to Cheng for verification and infra oncall for rollout.

cheng-l: I'll own the KMS investigation. Need PoC payloads from the bundle and to know KMS client versions in staging/prod. Staging is libkms 2.0.1; prod is 1.9.8.

iris: I'll own observability gaps and produce acceptance queries. Assessors flagged missing correlation IDs for async jobs. Short-term: add request_id propagation and example queries.

samir: Proposed workflow: 1) create JIRA per finding, 2) patch behind feature flag in staging, 3) run QA/exploit harness, 4) schedule retest 48-72h after merge.

alex-k: Include a proof-of-fix checklist on each ticket with exact log lines and KMS decrypt traces to look for. Example checklist items: deploy patched role to staging, rotate ephemeral tokens for CI runners, trigger sample request that previously leaked headers, confirm audit log shows denied assume_role entries, confirm KMS DECRYPT logs with request_id and result=OK.

maria-s: I'll name tickets ENGSEC-3141 (kube role) and ENGSEC-3142 (CI token policy). Assign Cheng for verification.

cheng-l: Please add the PoC payloads to the ticket. Also we need a compatibility plan if we recommend upgrading prod KMS clients.

alex-k: PoC payloads are under /pocs/kms_misuse/ in the bundle. We should avoid key rotation in prod before retest unless necessary.

iris: For the retest acceptance criteria, I will draft the exact log queries and expected strings/time ranges and attach to each ticket.

samir: Verification artifacts required for closure: audit export CSV with denied assume_role events, KMS operation logs with request_ids/key_id, patched role diffs and helm chart tag, and replayable harness output.

maria-s: Kickoff asks: can security ops host a 30-min remediation kickoff today? Who will hand evidence to the assessor for retest?

alex-k: I'm available at 14:00. @penbot can you create a shortlived readroom URL for the assessor after we finalize fixes?

penbot: Readroom link created: https://readroom.redwood.internal/acme/3141592653?token=xxxx (expires 72h). Access logged to audit.bucket_access.

cheng-l: Proposed retest windows: Thu 2026-03-26 06:00-10:00 UTC (staging only) and Fri 2026-03-27 08:00-12:00 UTC (prod smoke if needed).

iris: I'll include the exact queries and example log lines for the assessor to run in the tickets.

samir: Create coordination ticket ENGSEC-COORD-314159 with links to each fix ticket and retest windows; invite assessor contact.

maria-s: Aiming for remediation PRs by EOD, will update the tickets with owners and acceptance artifacts.

alex-k: If regression occurs during retest, infra oncall will have rollback runbook and we will open an emergency bridge channel. Also add a short runbook for pinning KMS client to 1.9.8 if needed.

penbot: Reminder: assessor requested retest slot at 13:30. Please confirm final window by EOD to lock.

samir: Plan recap: triage -> tickets -> patch -> QA harness -> retest windows. Ping here with blockers.

alex-k: Add a post-engagement action item for infra to review KMS client upgrade policy.

maria-s: Kickoff at 14:00. :thumbsup:
